notes:
Crisp now understands both halves of a phrasal verb.

"Smooth out the shakiness" worked; "smooth the shakiness out" started a full upscale instead — the same sentence, with the last word moved. "Tone the colours down" and "turn the sound off" reached nothing at all. Crisp now tries the other word order whenever it does not recognise a request, so both ways of saying something land in the same place. Anything that already worked is untouched.
